title: Panning in acre-gui draws the whole scene again on every frame
body:
`View::show` in `crates/acre-gui/src/view.rs` draws the scene again whenever the zoom, the offset or the pane's size changes. A drag changes the offset on every frame. So each frame of a pan builds every primitive, sets every label's glyphs as paths, rasterizes the whole pane in software through `render::draw_view`, and uploads the texture. Jack finds panning laggy on `examples/prefix-encoder.acre` in the debug build. The release build does the same work per frame, more quickly.

## Proposal

- While the person drags, paint the last texture shifted by the drag, and draw the scene again when the drag stops.
- Draw a margin around the pane, so a short pan shows drawn content and not an empty edge.
- While zooming with the wheel, stretch the last texture and draw a sharp one once the wheel stops.

## Open

- Whether to cache glyph paths in `render`, so each full redraw costs less as well.
